title: The Three Fish
logline: Three fish hear that fishermen will come back with nets: one leaves at once, one waits and escapes only by playing dead, and one who shrugged it off is caught.
moral: Act while the way is open. Cleverness can rescue you late, but carelessness about danger cannot.
tone: A gentle pond comedy that tightens into suspense, a clever escape and a quiet, sad catch, ending in open water. Warm, never cruel.

beats.summary: Three fish share a quiet, hidden pond.
The pond has one way out: a narrow stream to the river. The escape route is planted early.
Peace. Fish 3 floats belly-up for fun: the pose that will later save Fish 2 (setup for the payoff).
Fish 1: wise, decides at once.
Fish 2: clever, but dithers between two crumbs while Fish 3 steals one.
Fish 3: never thinks of danger (bonks into the rock with eyes shut, laughs).
Two fishermen pass; footfalls ring the surface.
The threat is spoken: tomorrow, with nets.
All three are afraid, each in her own way.
Fish 1 acts at once and leaves by the stream.
Fish 1 is safe in the wide river.
Fish 2 turns back from the open stream mouth: she stays to think, while the sun is already sinking.
Fish 3 waves the danger away and goes on playing.
Morning: the fishermen are back with big nets.
They block the stream. The way out is gone.
Fish 2 bounces off the barrier.
She remembers the belly-up float: one last trick.
She floats like a dead fish; the men are fooled.
Laid beside the river, she flips into it and escapes.
Fish 3 darts every way and finds nowhere to hide.
Fish 3 is caught. The pond is empty.
The two who acted swim free in the wide river, far from the old pond.

cast.name: the third fish (carefree)

sets.description: One split-level cutaway world, 2200 x 1230. Top: Library sky, sun, treeRow and a far-bank grass strip whose ground line is y 470 (people walk here, feet at y 462). Below: water in cross-section with its surface at y 500. Pond basin x 90..910, bowl bed to y 1090, with a rock at (300, 1060), a weed clump at (640, 1080), three lily pads and reeds. Narrow stream x 910..1330, only 85 deep (y 500..585), pebble bed. River x 1330..2200, bed y 1160, running off the right edge, with a rock-and-weed nook at (1950, 1110). Cut earth in ochre and brown with halftone and stones (as wellShaft). Sky presets day, dusk, night, dawn.

props.description: Pole with a hoop and a mesh bag; a fish can hang inside it.
Large net: rolled on a pole, unrolled on the bank, hanging as a wall from floats on the surface to weights on the bed, and closed into a bag.
Two stakes with mesh across the stream mouth at x 915; bulges when struck.
A small green leaf that floats on the surface.
Flat green pad with a notch, part of the pond set, bobbing on the surface.

scenes.summary: Three character portraits, each a tiny gag that the later story repays. Fish 1 reacts to a shadow at once. Fish 2 cannot choose between two crumbs. Fish 3 swims with her eyes shut into the rock and laughs. Then all three together.
scenes.composition: Each portrait keeps the fish in the upper middle of the panel with its name label in a corner box, never over the face. The rock (pond bed x 300) is in two of the three portraits so the geography stays readable.

scenes.summary: Footfalls ring the surface before anyone is seen. Two fishermen walk the far bank; the tall one stops (the short one walks into him), leans over, counts the fish and promises nets tomorrow. Below, the three fish freeze, then fear arrives in three different ways.

camera.notes: Split-level {500,615,1.0} from 42.54. 47.9 push to the men {560,420,1.5}. 49.9 tilt down so both levels show {540,600,1.15} (man above, fish below). 53.9 back up {560,430,1.45}. 57.9 tilt down and push in on the fish {480,800,1.9}; hold to 63.4.

scenes.composition: Vertical staging is the idea of the scene: men in the top third looking down, fish in the lower third looking up, the surface line between them. The pointing finger, the arrow and the upward pupils form one diagonal eye line.

scenes.summary: Fish 1 decides and goes: a shake of the head, a fin toward the stream, an invitation the others do not take, then one dart through the tight stream into the huge river and a safe nook.

scenes.composition: The stream shot is the tightest framing of the film (zoom 2.4) so that the river pull-out to zoom 1.0 feels enormous. Fish 1 always swims left to right: right is safety for the whole film.

new_assets.name: fish
new_assets.description: A side-view comic fish with three palettes and body shapes (pal 0 sleek yellow, 1 red with white belly, 2 round pink). Pose fields: ph and amp (tail beat), bend (-1..1 body curve), rot (pitch), roll (0 upright, 1 belly-up), fin (pectoral fin angle, the fish hand), dorsal (0 flat, 1 raised), mouth (closed, smile, smirk, frown, o, open), talk, brow, eyes (open, wide, shut), puff (cheeks), limp (0..1 fins and tail hang).
new_assets.implementation: Body: one closed bezier path whose spine is bent by bend (3 spine points), fill flat colour, S.dots shading on the back, 7 px black outline. Tail: a two-lobe fan rotated by sin(ph) * amp at the spine end. Pectoral fin: small rounded triangle rotated by fin. Eye through core/helpers eye2 so gaze, lid and wet work. roll: scale Y by cos(roll * PI) clamped to at least 0.7 in magnitude through the flip (as turnFlip does) so the belly side and its dots end on top. Wrap with acting() in registry.js with a skin colour per palette; x, y is the body centre.

new_assets.name: pondStream
new_assets.description: Split-level cutaway of pond, narrow stream and river in one 2200-unit world, with sky presets. Reusable for any water fable (herons, crabs, frogs, turtles).
new_assets.implementation: bake() three layers: back (sky(), sun(), treeRow(), far-bank grass strip), water (one polygon for the basin, channel and river bed profile filled blue with S.dots, lighter band under the surface), front (cut earth polygon in ochre and brown with halftone and stones, outlined). Animated per frame: surface line as a low sine, current streaks in the river (seeded dashes moving right), lily pads, reeds via swing(). Expose anchor points (ROCK, WEEDS, STREAM_IN, STREAM_OUT, NOOK, BANK_SPOT).

new_assets.name: fishingNet
new_assets.description: One mesh drawing used four ways: handNet (hoop on a pole), bigNet (roll, spread, hanging wall, closed bag) and barrier (mesh between two stakes).
new_assets.implementation: mesh(ctx, quad or path, nx, ny, bulge): draw nx by ny lines by interpolating between the edges of a deformable quad, 3 px black lines over a 35 % paper fill so fish show through. Floats are yellow circles on the top edge. bulge pushes the middle rows sideways for drag and for the BOING rebound (settleTo). The bag is the same grid with the lower corners pulled together (close 0..1).

new_assets.name: villager
new_assets.description: Already planned by KD-005: parameterised person variants. Here two fishermen: tall thin with turban and moustache, short wide with cap and beard.
new_assets.implementation: person kind:'owner' with a costume layer: headwear, beard, tunic colour, width and height factors. If KD-005 has not built it yet, build it here with those parameters and move it to Library.

new_assets.name: swimPath
new_assets.description: Fish motion from a keyed 2D path: returns x, y, dir, rot, ph, amp, bend for any time.
new_assets.implementation: Position from kfn on x and y keys (or a bezier list); arc length by fixed sampling so ph = distance / stride (as swimPhase) and nothing slides; rot from the path slope clamped to 0.6; bend from the change of heading; amp from speed with an idle minimum; direction changes through turnFlip. Pure function of t.

new_assets.name: splash
new_assets.description: Crown of drops with rings when something enters or leaves the water; also bubble trails.
new_assets.implementation: Seeded drops on short ballistic arcs (as dustBurst but white with black outline and gravity) plus two ripple() rings. bubbles(ctx, x, y, t0, t, n): seeded circles rising with a sine wobble that pop at the surface y.

new_assets.name: dayCycle
new_assets.description: Already planned by KD-005: sky running day to dusk to night to dawn. Here: day until 86, dusk by 100, night at the card, dawn at 103.96, day again by 113.
new_assets.implementation: Blend between sky() presets by drawing two presets with alpha; sun on an arc. If not available, cross-fade two baked back layers.

new_assets.name: thoughtCloud
new_assets.description: Already planned by KD-005: thought cloud with a drawing inside. Used five times (net, crossed net, PLAN?, the belly-up memory, the old pond).
new_assets.implementation: cloud() from core/helpers with a clipped inside callback at a scale that keeps a fish at least 110 px long on screen.

implementation_notes: World is 2200 x 1230 (WW = 2200). Clamp the camera with WW = 2200. Panel shows 1000 x 1230 world units at zoom 1; never zoom below 1.0.
Screen direction: the river and safety are always to the right; the men come from the right on day one, leave left, and return from the left.
Every fish position comes from swimPath so the tail phase follows distance; idle fish still breathe (amp 0.25) and blink (LIFE.t = t).
The belly-up pose must be the same fields at 18.68 (Fish 3), inside the thought cloud at 122.74 and at 129.12 (Fish 2): define one constant FLOAT = {roll: 1, limp: 1, eyes: "shut", mouth: "open"}.
The dash at 113.72-117.1 reuses the camera keys and path of 69.18-72.4 shifted in time, ending at the barrier (x 915).

Draw order for the split level: back layer, people on the far bank, water, fish and nets, front earth, surface line and lily pads, then lettering. The bank spot (1450, 455) is on the far bank, so Fish 2 lying there is drawn with the people, in front of the grass.
Balloons, labels and the ! never cover a face; counters sit above heads. Lettering total is about 40 including labels; drop HMM..., FWUMP! and FREE first if the frame feels busy.
SFX only at the listed times (all in measured gaps). The splash at 143.90 and the BOING at 118.2 are deliberately silent because the narrator is speaking.
Use panel-only shake for the bump (47.55), BONK (34.38), BOING (118.2) and the S8 direction flips.
Scene S8 and S9 both belong to paragraph 8 (split at 158.46, the word starting the river sentence).
Subtitles: Arabic verbatim from the script with diacritics, English beneath; nothing in this plan changes the text.
warnings: The fish figure is the main new drawing and carries the whole film; get three clearly different silhouettes approved on a still before staging.

The script says the men placed the second fish near the river; the plan lays her on the far bank directly above the river water at x 1450. Check that this reads as near the river and not as back in the pond.
The third fish is caught, not shown harmed: the plan stops at the net leaving the water. Confirm this restraint is wanted for the audience.
villager, dayCycle and thoughtCloud are planned by KD-005 but not in Library yet; whichever story is animated first must build them.
ACT IN TIME under THE END is added lettering stating the moral; remove it if only THE END is wanted.

subtitles.ar: كانت ثلاث سمكات تعيش في بركة هادئة بين الأشجار.|كان هناك نهر قريب، يصل إلى البركة بمجرى صغير.|نادرًا ما جاء الناس إلى هذا المكان، فكانت السمكات تسبح مطمئنة كل يوم.
subtitles.en: Three fish lived in a quiet pond among the trees.|A nearby river was connected to the pond by a narrow stream.|People rarely came to that place, so the fish swam peacefully every day.

subtitles.ar: كانت السمكة الأولى حكيمة وسريعة القرار،|والثانية ذكية لكنها تتردد أحيانًا،|أما الثالثة فلم تكن تفكر في الأخطار.|ورغم اختلافها، عاشت السمكات الثلاث معًا في البركة.
subtitles.en: The first fish was wise and quick to decide.|The second was clever but sometimes hesitated.|The third rarely thought about danger.|Despite their differences, the three fish lived together in the pond.

subtitles.ar: في أحد الأيام، مرّ صيادان قرب الماء.|نظر أحدهما إلى البركة وقال: «انظر إلى هذه الأسماك!|سنعود غدًا بالشباك ونصطادها.»|سمعت السمكات كلام الرجلين، وشعرت بالخوف.
subtitles.en: One day, two fishermen passed by the water.|One looked into the pond and said, “Look at those fish!|We will come back tomorrow with nets and catch them.”|The fish heard the men and became afraid.

subtitles.ar: قالت السمكة الأولى: «لن أنتظر عودتهما.»|سبحت فورًا عبر المجرى الضيق، ووصلت إلى النهر الواسع.|هناك وجدت مكانًا آمنًا بعيدًا عن الشباك.
subtitles.en: “I will not wait for them to return,” said the first fish.|She immediately swam through the narrow stream into the wide river.|There she found a safe place far from the nets.

subtitles.ar: أما السمكة الثانية فقالت: «لدينا وقت حتى الغد.»|بقيت في البركة تبحث عن خطة.|وأما الثالثة فقالت: «لا تقلقا! ربما لن يعود الصيادان أصلًا.»|ثم واصلت السباحة واللعب.
subtitles.en: The second fish said, “We have until tomorrow.”|She stayed in the pond, looking for a plan.|The third said, “Do not worry! Perhaps the fishermen will not come back at all.”|Then she carried on swimming and playing.

subtitles.ar: لكن الصيادين عادا في الصباح ومعهما شباك كبيرة.|أغلقا المجرى المؤدي إلى النهر.|حاولت السمكة الثانية الهرب، لكنها وجدت الطريق مسدودًا.|عندئذ فكرت بسرعة في حيلة أخيرة.
subtitles.en: But the fishermen returned in the morning with large nets.|They blocked the stream leading to the river.|The second fish tried to escape but found the way closed.|Then she quickly thought of one last trick.

subtitles.ar: استلقت السمكة الثانية على ظهرها، وتركت جسمها يطفو بلا حركة.|ظن الصيادان أنها ميتة، فأخرجاها من الماء ووضعاها قرب النهر.|فجأة، قفزت إلى الماء وسبحت بعيدًا.
subtitles.en: The second fish rolled onto her back and let her body float without moving.|The fishermen thought she was dead, took her out, and placed her near the river.|Suddenly, she jumped into the water and swam away.

subtitles.ar: أما السمكة الثالثة فسبحت في كل اتجاه، ولم تعرف أين تختبئ.|وقعت أخيرًا في شبكة الصيادين.|وفي النهر الواسع، كانت السمكتان الأخريان تسبحان بحرية، بعيدًا عن البركة القديمة.
subtitles.en: The third fish darted in every direction, unable to find a hiding place.|At last, she was caught in the fishermen’s net.|In the wide river, the other two fish swam freely, far from their old pond.
